# Wolai

Wolai is a theme inspired by the design of Wolai, and its recorded description is written in Chinese. That description states that the theme offers paired light and dark modes, tunes Chinese typography through the PingFang SC and Microsoft YaHei fonts together with line spacing, improves the rendering of code blocks, tables and blockquotes, and adopts a rounded, card-style interface.

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Wolai"
    author: "liicos"
    repo:   "liicos/obsidian-wolai-theme"
    slug:   "wolai"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/wolai"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/liicos/obsidian-wolai-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liicos/obsidian-wolai-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png%20"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "应用受 Wolai 设计启发的简洁现代主题，呈现干净、低干扰的笔记界面。切换亮/暗双模式并优化中文字体（PingFang SC、微软雅黑）、行距与排版，改善代码块、表格与引用的显示，采用圆角卡片式 UI。"
}
```
